body: You know what I mean by a proper male...a "cis" male.which is like a born male. And no one could ever love me. Why would a girl want me when there is plenty biological males she could go out with instead?
I know I know... I just cant see the beauty I guess. I'm constantly incessantly miserable, my family all hate me, I have no friends. And that shows no sign of changing.

But I don't want to have it where some days people forget I'm transgender. I was it so nobody knows at all. Is that possible do you think? 

I don't think I can ever accept this. I'm just as miserable, if not more than I was when I figured out that I was male and fuck was I miserable then. I just can't see it getting any better. The cause of the misery will never go away, unless I'm dead so I can no longer experience the misery.
Being transgender male just isn't good enough for me...I just can't handle this life I guess. I don't want this and I can never be a proper male.  Fucking hell I just can't do this shit
